result.title: Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability
result.summary: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在目标条件强化学习中提出 ReQRL，用有限时域可达性约束 critic 的价值梯度，将动力学可达性与边界几何解耦并分别从数据估计，在 OGBench 上超过或比肩现有 quasimetric 方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用有限时域可达性约束价值几何」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的可达性、停止决策与计算价值相关，可供核查是否用于刻画推理状态的可达边界与终止条件。
